answer.value:
Krishna River is the second major river of South India. It originates at a place called Mahabaleshwar in Maharashtra and flows eastwards for a distance of 1392 km and joins the Bay of Bengal. It flows for 480 km in Karnataka.
Bhima, Tungabhadra, Ghataprabha and Malaprabha are its tributaries.
